JsonlProgressEvent.title: uv JSONL progress (preview)
JsonlProgressEvent.description:
A progress update emitted before a command's final JSONL result.

Concurrent operations are correlated using their process-wide `id`. Top-level
phases omit `id`, since only one instance of each phase is active at a time.
Operations can complete without an intermediate update.

completed.description: Completed bytes for transfers, or completed packages for package phases.

id.description: A process-wide identifier shared by all events for one concurrent operation.

name.description: The package, distribution, or source currently being processed.

phase.description: The operation being reported, such as `download`, `build`, or `install`.

revision.description: The Git revision associated with a checkout operation.

total.description: The fixed total bytes or packages for this operation, when known.

type.description: Distinguishes progress updates from the final command result.

url.description: The source URL associated with a resolution or checkout operation.

version.description: The selected package version, when available.

JsonlResult.description: An object-valued command result with the JSONL discriminator.

commit_info.description:
Information about the git commit we may have been built from.

`None` if not built from a git repo or if retrieval failed.

target_triple.description: The target triple for which uv was built (e.g., `x86_64-unknown-linux-gnu`).

type.description: Distinguishes the final command result from progress updates.

ProgressPhase.description: An operation reported by the preview JSONL interface.

ProgressStatus.description: The lifecycle of an operation: started, optionally updated, then completed.
